fixture.browser: Chromium headless with ephemeral extension profile
fixture.domWorkload: 250 ordinary post-like rows; four replacement batches per 10-second phase; each batch changes class, inline style, and child text
fixture.notMeasured: Real Mattermost post rendering or virtualization behavior
fixture.counter: Blocking-dialog selector calls in the extension isolated world, split between Document and Element querySelectorAll
fixture.taskDuration: CDP page-wide TaskDuration; includes fixture, extension, probe, and measurement overhead
fixture.hiddenSimulation: 95 seconds with document.hidden/visibilityState set to hidden and visibilitychange dispatched in the extension isolated world; Chromium window remains headless and active

visibleMutationWindows.interpretation: Full-document scans declined 6 to 2 per 10-second phase. The remaining two are consistent with the 5-second visible route fallback. TaskDuration medians were 31.864ms baseline and 32.688ms after; the page-wide noisy samples do not establish a CPU-time improvement. First-phase node growth is fixture initialization.

hiddenPhase.interpretation: Route fallback scans stopped while hidden. The first API health timer tick did not qualify as idle for 90 seconds after app-ready, so health fetch count was zero in both runs; no health-network reduction is claimed. The two /users/me requests in each run are independently classified session-heartbeat fetches and remain unchanged.

afterFunctionalCheck.note: Separate short functional check with corrected positioned visible dialog geometry; not included in the full performance timing.

longAfterRunNote: The full performance measurements completed, then its first modal z-index assertion failed because the synthetic dialog had no layout box. The corrected short functional run passed; long-run dialog transition values are excluded.
